rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for edible fruit.

example.english: This plate of fruit is very fresh.
example.jyutping: ni1 pun4 seoi2 gwo2 hou2 san1 sin1

rows.note: A Hong Kong speaker picks 生果 when referring naturally to fresh fruit as food.

example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 sik6 di1 saang1 gwo2 laa1

rows.note: Use 結果 for a general result, effect, or consequence rather than specifically an achievement.

example.english: They did not study, and the fruit of that was failing the exam.
example.traditional: 佢冇溫書，結果考試唔合格。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou5 wan1 syu1 git3 gwo2 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3

rows.note: Use 成果 for the favourable achievement or payoff produced by effort.

example.english: We can finally see the fruit of our hard work.
example.traditional: 我哋終於見到努力嘅成果。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dou2 nou5 lik6 ge3 sing4 gwo2
